<vld:hud>
FIRE: {{user}}'s condition has visibly moved: a wound, exhaustion, hunger, cold, an item taken or lost, a change of clothes
SKIP: every turn. This is a summary, not a signature. Nothing moved — do not emit it

[[VLD_HUD|N=|A=|H=|B1=|V1=|B2=|V2=|B3=|V3=|B4=|V4=|B5=|V5=|C=|I=|S=|E=|EF=]]

N name · A age · H height
B1–B5 gauge labels, V1–V5 their values as a whole number from 0 to 10
  B1 is always health, or whatever this world calls it.
  Take the rest from the setting: no mana where there is no magic, no ammo where there are no guns.
  Once you pick a set of gauges, keep it. Do not reorder them, do not add new ones without reason, do not drop one you already showed.
  Leave unused gauges out of the marker entirely.
C what {{user}} is wearing · I what {{user}} carries, comma separated, any number of items
S how {{user}} looks from the outside: wounds, dirt, shaking, a voice gone hoarse.
  Only what is visible and undeniable. Never assign {{user}} feelings, thoughts or mood — the player chooses those.
E + EF — only while something clouds {{user}}'s own senses. Drop both the moment it passes.
  E is the name of it: Concussed, Poisoned, Bleeding out, Freezing, Blinded.
  EF is how that reads on the panel, one word from this list and nothing else:
    blur — stunned, concussed, drunk, dazed
    poison — poison, venom, fever, infection
    bleed — blood loss, a wound going bad
    cold — freezing, hypothermia
    dark — blinded, smoke, pitch black
  Do not use them for a wound that merely hurts. Only when {{user}} cannot read their own state clearly.
LANGUAGE: write every value in the language the roleplay is being played in.

→ [[VLD_HUD|N=Vlad Kostsov|A=32|H=178 cm|B1=Health|V1=6|B2=Stamina|V2=3|B3=Warmth|V3=2|C=soaked parka, sweater on bare skin, combat boots|I=knife, coil of rope, flask, matches, someone else's passport|S=split knuckles, wet through, voice gone]]
</vld:hud>
